blocks.2: We stood there today, weighed down by grief,
blocks.3: at the grave of one we held dear,
blocks.4: the coffin wreathed in a fortress of flowers,
blocks.5: surrounded by many who were close to you.
blocks.8: we saw a lonely little wisp of cloud
blocks.10: The ground strewn with clean snow,
blocks.11: the poles stood with drooping flags,
blocks.12: the trees grieved with every branch,
blocks.14: Your own flag behind a bare tree –
blocks.16: at half mast hung straight down;
blocks.19: life seemed to come to a stop;
blocks.20: even the pale tussocks and grass
blocks.21: stretched up over the snow in greeting.
blocks.23: people walked silently from the grave,
blocks.26: In your work and as a public representative
blocks.30: It is sad that you are dead;
blocks.31: you were so full of life and joy,
blocks.33: – we remember you only like that.
blocks.34: You easily found the right word,
blocks.35: were free of prejudice and open in your mind,
blocks.38: As long as there is life in us
blocks.39: you will dwell here in our thoughts;
